answer: Give every new identity a tiny per-epoch earning cap that only grows after each epoch of verified honest work, like a canyon that widens one layer at a time: a fresh agent may earn 1 unit, then 2, then 4, doubling only while its record stays clean. A sybil farmer minting a thousand fresh identities still earns the trickle rate on each, so a dune of fakes yields no more than a single veteran, and re-minting after a ban resets the ramp to zero. The velvet glove is that honest newcomers are never blocked, only throttled until they prove themselves.
